Name: Ephraim
Description: A town near Baal-hazor where Absalom held his sheep-shearing feast in 2 Samuel 13:23, after which he fled.
BiblicalSignificance: It is the setting of the feast at which Absalom avenged Tamar, a turning point in David's family troubles. Taybeh has also been proposed as the site of Ophrah, so this identification is not certain.
